output.reply: Thanks for reaching out. Sorry you're locked out of your account because the reset link is going to your old work inbox. Please reply with your old email address and the new one you'd like to use. Our team will verify your ownership of the account and help you switch the email so you can sign in again.

Hi Maria, thanks for letting us know about the duplicate $9.99 charge for Lumen Plus dated the 3rd. We've passed this to our billing team to review the charges on your account, and they will follow up with you about the duplicate charge. Thanks for your patience!

I'm sorry about the unexpected $120 charge for the annual plan after you cancelled in March. Could you reply with the cancellation confirmation email or its details so our billing team can review your account and the charge? We'll follow up as soon as we've looked into it.

Thanks for reaching out! Lumen lets you export your notes, and we'll share the steps for exporting all of them as Markdown files so you have a full backup before your trip. If anything in the export doesn't look right, just reply here and we'll help.

Thanks for reporting this. Tables pasted from Google Sheets into Lumen on Chrome are collapsing into a single line of text, and this worked fine last week. We've passed the details to our team to investigate, and we'll follow up if we need more information, such as a sample of the table you're pasting.

Thanks for the suggestion! A dark mode that automatically follows your system setting is a great idea, and I've passed it along to our product team. In the meantime, the manual toggle remains available whenever you need it.

Thank you for letting us know. We understand your whole team is seeing 'Cannot reach server' and can't open your notes ahead of your presentation, and we've escalated this to our engineering team for immediate investigation. We'll update you as soon as we have more information.

Thank you for reporting this, and sorry that the app is closing when you open notes with attached PDFs on iOS since the last update. We have passed this to our team to investigate. Could you tell us your iOS version, your Lumen app version, and roughly how large the attached PDFs are?

Thanks for reaching out! To share a notebook, open it, click the Share button, and enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite or copy a share link. You can choose whether each person can view or edit the notebook.

You can change your display name from your account settings under Profile; once you update and save it, new and existing comments should show the new name. If the old nickname still appears after saving, try reloading the app and let us know if it persists.

Thank you for reporting this — we're treating it as a possible unauthorized access to your account. Please change your password right away, enable two-factor authentication, and remove the unknown address from your notebook shares if you can. Our security team will review the login activity and follow up with you.
Thanks for reaching out. We've passed your request on to our billing team: an invoice made out to Brandt Logistics GmbH with VAT number DE123456789. They'll follow up with you by email.
Thanks for spotting this! We've noted that the footer word count shows 0 words for notes containing only emoji and passed it to our team to look into.

Sorry the recent update made Settings harder to find. You should be able to turn off the weekly summary emails in your account's notification settings, under email preferences. If you can't find that option, reply here and we'll guide you step by step.

Sorry that sync has been stuck on 'Syncing...' on your phone and laptop, and that search isn't returning any results. We're looking into both issues; could you tell us your app versions and operating systems, and whether any notes were edited offline before sync stalled? We'll follow up once we know more.

Thanks for these suggestions: pinning notes to the top of a notebook, setting a default font size, and keeping notes in the trash for 60 days instead of 30. I've passed all three to our product team for consideration. We can't share timelines, but your feedback helps shape what we build next.

Thank you for this suggestion and for explaining how it would help your team of 12. We've passed your request for a version history that shows who edited a note and when to our product team. We can't promise if or when it will be available, but your feedback helps us prioritize.

I'm sorry your meeting notes were lost after the reload. Your ticket has been escalated to our engineering team to investigate why the note was emptied and whether any content can be recovered. Please share your device, app version, and the approximate time it happened to help us look into it.

Hola, lamentamos que no puedas acceder a tu cuenta y que no te lleguen los correos de restablecimiento. Por favor, revisa tu carpeta de spam y confírmanos la dirección de correo asociada a tu cuenta para que podamos investigarlo. Nuestro equipo revisará el caso y te ayudará a recuperar el acceso.
Thanks for suggesting an Android widget for Lumen! I've passed your request along to our product team so they can consider it for future planning.

Thank you for your kind words and for the clear description of your reorganization plans. We'll confirm exactly how internal links behave when a note is moved between notebooks, and what happens to comments and edit history when two notebooks are merged. In the meantime, you could test the steps on a couple of duplicated sample notes before touching your real research data.

Sorry the mobile app is showing 'temporarily unavailable' again, especially on a third Monday morning in a row. We've passed this to our team to investigate, and any service updates will be posted on our status page. Thank you for letting us know about the repeated timing, as it helps us look into the cause.

Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on making it to your second year! Our team will let you know whether a student discount or any other pricing option is currently available for the Plus plan. In the meantime, you can keep using Lumen's free plan with no interruption.

Thank you for reporting this, and we're sorry your office can't reach Lumen this morning. We've passed the Error 503 reports to our engineering team as a priority, and we'll send you updates as soon as we have more information. You can also follow our status page for the latest news.

Thanks for reporting both issues: the freeze when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes in the Windows desktop app, and Ctrl+B sometimes inserting a literal 'b' instead of applying bold. We've passed both to our team to investigate. If you can share your app version and Windows version, that will help us look into them.

Sorry you've been locked out, and we understand you need your documents today. Our account team will help verify your identity and restore access since your two-factor device and recovery codes are unavailable. Please reply from the email address on your Lumen account so we can begin the verification process.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Vous pouvez mettre à jour votre carte bancaire depuis la section Abonnement ou Facturation de vos paramètres de compte, via l'option de modification du moyen de paiement. Si vous ne voyez pas cette option, dites-nous sur quel appareil vous êtes et nous vous guiderons.

Thanks for reporting this, and sorry the images from your Evernote import are showing as broken icons. We're looking into it; could you share roughly how many notes are affected, the format you exported from Evernote (ENEX or HTML), and a sample note name? We'll then advise whether the attachments can be re-linked or whether a re-import is the best option.

Thanks for reporting this. We're looking into why your two new teammates can't see the shared notebooks, and we'll also check why your account still shows the free plan after the $48 Team upgrade charge. We'll update you on both as soon as we know more.

Thanks for letting us know that Lumen feels slow today. Could you tell us which device and app version you're using, and which actions are slow (opening notes, syncing, searching)? That will help our team look into it.

Thank you for considering Lumen for your team, and for explaining that Okta single sign-on is a hard requirement for your security team. I've passed your request for SAML support to our product team along with your evaluation details. I can't share a timeline right now, but someone from our team will follow up with you.

Thanks for reporting this. Sorry the share link lumen.example/s/ab12 is showing a 404 page to your coworkers. We've passed the link to our team to investigate and will follow up with you as soon as we know more.

Thank you for letting us know, and we're sorry for the trouble this charge has caused. We're escalating your case to our billing team right away so they can review the $480 charge against the $48 you expected. We'll follow up with you as soon as we have the details.

Thanks for the suggestion! Alphabetical sorting for notes isn't available right now, but I've passed your request along to our product team for consideration. We appreciate you taking the time to share feedback.

Thanks for reaching out. We're sorry to see you go and will help you delete your account and its data. We'll confirm exactly what is removed and how long the process takes, along with the steps to complete the deletion.

Thanks for letting us know that image uploads have been failing since this morning with the 'Upload failed, try again' error. We're looking into this and may ask for details such as your device, app version and the file type and size of the screenshots. In the meantime, your text notes remain safe and accessible.

Thanks for reaching out! We'll look into whether Lumen can hold both a work and a personal account on the same phone, and how to switch between them, and get back to you with the details. If you let us know whether you use iPhone or Android, we can tailor the answer to your device.

Thanks for flagging this. We understand how distracting it is to see 'Lumen' marked as a typo in your own notes, and we've passed it on to our team to look into. In the meantime, you may be able to add the word to your device or browser dictionary so it stops being underlined.

Thanks for reaching out! You can enable offline mode from the app's settings, and we'll confirm for you whether it also covers notebooks your teammates have shared with you. We'll also follow up with the storage allowance included in the Plus plan.

Thanks for reaching out, and we understand you need this by end of day. We'll check how note templates work in Lumen and send you the exact steps to save your standup note so the whole team can reuse it. In the meantime, you can share the standup note with your team so they can duplicate it each week.
